title: Genie Agents — Meridian Financial Group lab
description: A synthetic US bank with nine deliberate data-quality flaws. Every flaw is the raw material for a specific module: gross vs net revenue, a fiscal year starting 1 October, region codes users never say out loud, DECLINED rows inflating counts, two competing product hierarchies, a daily-snapshot table that invites a 30x fan-out, four meanings of 'delinquent', unmasked PII, and multi-currency needing an as-of-date join.

small.description: 20M transactions. Every module except 13. Start here.

large.description: 900M transactions, left unclustered on purpose. Module 13 (latency) only.

notebooks.name: 01_catalog_and_schemas
notebooks.title: 01 · Catalog and schemas
notebooks.intro:
Creates the `{{CATALOG}}` catalog, the core / ref / staging schemas, and the documents volume.

Run this first. Everything else depends on it.

notebooks.name: 02_dimensions
notebooks.title: 02 · Dimensions
notebooks.intro:
Six dimensions, planting five of the nine flaws: the 1 October fiscal year, region and state stored as codes, two competing product hierarchies, unmasked PII, and multi-currency FX rates.

Every value derives from `hash()` of the row key rather than `rand()`, so your data is byte-identical to everyone else's and the benchmark answers in Module 11 stay valid.

notebooks.name: 03_facts
notebooks.title: 03 · Facts
notebooks.intro:
Five fact tables carrying the four remaining flaws.

**This is the slow one** — it generates {{TXN_COUNT}} transactions plus roughly 35M daily loan-balance snapshots. Expect several minutes on a small warehouse.
